sql.ahj.hoa.list.all: SELECT h.id, h.name, cs.id as company_state_id, cs.state_id, s.state, s.abbreviation as state_abbreviation, lov.id as management_company_id, lov.name as management_company, h.archived FROM brs.ahj_hoa h left join brs.list_of_value lov on lov.id = h.management_company_id and lov.parent_id = 759 left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = h.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id ORDER BY s.state, h.name;
sql.ahj.hoa.simple.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_hoa SET name = :hoaName, archived = :archived, company_state_id = :companyStateId, management_company_id = :managementCompanyId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.hoa.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_hoa SET name = :hoaName, archived = :archived, company_state_id = :companyStateId, management_company_id = :managementCompanyId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.hoa.insert: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_hoa(name, archived, company_state_id, management_company_id, date_created, created_by_id,date_modified, modified_by_id) VALUES (:hoaName, false, :companyStateId, :managementCompanyId, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser)
sql.ahj.hoa.detailById: SELECT h.*, mc.name as management_company, cs.state_id, s.state, s.abbreviation, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_hoa_contact auc ON c.id = auc.ahj_contact_id WHERE auc.ahj_hoa_id = h.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 10 ) contacts), '[]') AS contacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT aul.id, aul.name, aul.link, aul.username, aul.link_type_id AS "linkTypeId", aul.password, aul.notes FROM brs.ahj_hoa_link aul WHERE aul.archived IS FALSE AND aul.link_type_id = 11 AND aul.ahj_hoa_id = h.id) links ), '[]') AS links FROM brs.ahj_hoa h left join brs.list_of_value mc on mc.id = h.management_company_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = h.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE h.id = :id
sql.ahj.hoa.getActiveManagementCompanies: SELECT lov.id, lov.name as "managementCompany", lov.archived FROM brs.list_of_value lov WHERE lov.parent_id = 759 AND lov.archived IS FALSE ORDER BY lov.name
sql.ahj.hoa.contact.add: WITH auc AS ( insert into brs.ahj_contact (name, title, email, phone_number, address, notes, hours, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, contact_type_id) values (:name, :title, :email, :phoneNumber, :address, :notes, :hours, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser, :contactTypeId) returning id ) INSERT INTO brs.ahj_hoa_contact (ahj_hoa_id, ahj_contact_id) SELECT :ahjHoaId, auc.id FROM auc RETURNING ahj_contact_id;
sql.ahj.hoa.contact.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_contact SET name = :name, title = :title, email = :email, phone_number = :phoneNumber, address = :address, notes = :notes, hours = :hours, modified_by_id = :currentUser, date_modified = now() WHERE id = :contactId
sql.ahj.hoa.contact.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_contact SET archived = TRUE, modified_by_id = :currentUser, date_modified = now() WHERE id = :contactId
sql.ahj.hoa.link.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_hoa_link SET ahj_hoa_id = :ahjHoaId, name = :name, link = :link, username = :username, password = :password, notes = :notes, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.hoa.link.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_hoa_link SET archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
